reason: This plugin is primarily a user-interface localization plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it adds a Taiwan Traditional Chinese language option and rewrites interface copy to Taiwan terminology. Evidence shows it is installed as a DSH web plugin, injects into the web client, patches locale translation for zh-Hant, and applies additional label replacements in the DOM. It stores selected language in existing settings for persistence and states it only changes interface text, not user message content.

summaries.zh: 此插件為 DeepSeek Harness 提供台灣繁體中文本地化，新增語言選單項目並套用台灣慣用語詞彙，讓介面文字改為台灣用語顯示。
summaries.en: This plugin localizes the DeepSeek Harness web UI to Taiwan Traditional Chinese by adding a zh-Hant language option and applying Taiwan-oriented terminology replacements to interface text.

capabilities: Locale selection and UI language option injection
Terminology replacement via Taiwan-specific phrase mapping
Locale selection and UI language option injection
Terminology replacement via Taiwan-specific phrase mapping
